name: io.github.vonzelle-vzt/video-intel
description: Temporal scene-graph MCP server that gives Claude video understanding — transcript, scenes, entities, actions, OCR, keyframes, semantic search. Zero install, no Docker, no GPU.

environmentVariables.description: Replicate API token. Optional — enables cloud mode for heavy stages (entity tracking, action recognition). Without it, the server runs in lite mode (pure-Node WASM, free, offline) and skips those stages.
environmentVariables.name: REPLICATE_API_TOKEN
